facts: No snow or storms in the forecast this week; highs near 63°F at pass elevation.
No new snow measured at the 3 nearby stations in the 72 hours to Sep 28.

facts.text: The nearby stations disagree about this year: snow left Skookum Creek (3,320 ft) 10 days earlier, Alpine Meadows (3,500 ft) 22 days earlier and Cougar Mountain (3,210 ft) 9 days later than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Skookum Creek
evidence.detail: left May 5; earlier seasons: May 29 (2023), May 15 (2024), May 10 (2025)

evidence.name: Alpine Meadows
evidence.detail: left May 26; earlier seasons: June 23 (2023), June 17 (2024), June 2 (2025)

evidence.name: Cougar Mountain
evidence.detail: left April 19; earlier seasons: May 15 (2023), April 9 (2024), April 10 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the second highest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Cougar Mountain (3,210 ft) and the third highest at Skookum Creek (3,320 ft) and Alpine Meadows (3,500 ft).

evidence.name: Skookum Creek
evidence.detail: 23.0 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 53.3 in (2023), 22.9 in (2024), 26.2 in (2025)

evidence.name: Alpine Meadows
evidence.detail: 36.2 in on April 19; earlier seasons: 61.3 in (2023), 38.0 in (2024), 35.1 in (2025)

evidence.name: Cougar Mountain
evidence.detail: 4.4 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 20.4 in (2023), 0.7 in (2024), 3.0 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between February 21 and May 6, carried from the melt-out dates at 3 nearby stations to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Skookum Creek
evidence.detail: melted out May 5, 2,051 ft above the pass; points to February 21 to May 6

evidence.name: Alpine Meadows
evidence.detail: melted out May 26, 2,231 ft above the pass; points to March 10 to May 25

evidence.name: Cougar Mountain
evidence.detail: melted out April 19, 1,941 ft above the pass; points to February 8 to April 21
